title: QNN (NPU) recognizer backend and engine-aware transcriber factory
description: Run live English recognition on the Hexagon NPU through sherpa-onnx's QNN backend when the NPU engine is selected, with clear first-run and failure messages; no automatic fallback (the user chooses the engine) (goal 1).
steps: Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaAsrConfigs.kt`: `object SherpaAsrConfigs { val endpoint = EndpointConfig(rule1 = EndpointRule(false, 2.4f, 0.0f), rule2 = EndpointRule(true, 0.8f, 0.0f), rule3 = EndpointRule(false, 0.0f, 20.0f)); fun cpu(modelDir: File, asr: AsrFiles, numThreads: Int): OnlineRecognizerConfig; fun npu(modelDir: File, asr: AsrFiles): OnlineRecognizerConfig; fun contextBinaries(modelDir: File): List<File> = listOf("encoder.bin", "decoder.bin", "joiner.bin").map { File(modelDir, it) } }`. `cpu` = the config currently built inside `SherpaRecognizerBackend` (move it here). `npu` = `OnlineRecognizerConfig(featConfig = FeatureConfig(sampleRate = 16000, featureDim = 80), modelConfig = OnlineModelConfig(transducer = OnlineTransducerModelConfig(encoder = abs(asr.encoder), decoder = abs(asr.decoder), joiner = abs(asr.joiner), qnnConfig = QnnConfig(backendLib = "libQnnHtp.so", systemLib = "libQnnSystem.so", contextBinary = contextBinaries(modelDir).joinToString(",") { it.absolutePath })), tokens = abs(asr.tokens), numThreads = 1, provider = "qnn", modelType = asr.modelType), endpointConfig = endpoint, enableEndpoint = true, decodingMethod = "greedy_search")`. (The feature dimension is overridden from the model's metadata by sherpa; the three `.bin` context files are generated by QNN on first run and reused afterwards.)
Change `SherpaRecognizerBackend` to take an `OnlineRecognizerConfig` instead of building one.

Create `engine/sherpa/QnnRuntime.kt`: `object QnnRuntime { fun ensurePrepared(nativeLibraryDir: String) }` which calls `OnlineRecognizer.prependAdspLibraryPath(nativeLibraryDir)` once per process (guard with a synchronized flag). `SherpaTranscriberFactory` gets a `nativeLibraryDir: String` constructor parameter (`context.applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir` in `AppContainer`).

In `asr/TranscriberFactory.kt` add a default method to the fun interface: `fun needsPreparation(language: String): Boolean = false`. `SherpaTranscriberFactory.needsPreparation` returns true when the effective engine is npu and any of `SherpaAsrConfigs.contextBinaries(bundleDir)` is missing.

`SherpaTranscriberFactory.create`: if the effective engine is npu, `QnnRuntime.ensurePrepared(...)` then build the backend with `SherpaAsrConfigs.npu(...)`; any exception from creating the recognizer is rethrown as `IllegalStateException("The NPU engine failed to start (${e.message}). You can switch to the CPU engine in Settings.", e)`. CPU path unchanged. Remove the temporary "NPU engine not available yet" error.

`RecordingState` gets `val preparingNpu: Boolean = false`; `RecordingController.start` sets it from `transcriberFactory.needsPreparation(language())` together with phase LOADING. In `RecordScreen`, LOADING shows "Preparing the NPU model (first run only, this can take a few minutes)…" when `preparingNpu`, otherwise "Loading speech model…".
Write `engine/sherpa/SherpaAsrConfigsTest.kt` (allowed: it only builds config data classes; use a TemporaryFolder for modelDir) and extend `RecordingControllerTest`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `npu(dir, ASR_EN_NPU.asr!!)` has provider `qnn`, modelType `nemo_transducer`, encoder ending in `/libencoder.so`, backendLib `libQnnHtp.so`, systemLib `libQnnSystem.so`, and contextBinary equal to the three absolute `.bin` paths joined by commas
Test: `cpu(dir, ModelCatalog.ASR_EN.asr!!, 4)` has provider `cpu`, numThreads 4, modelType `zipformer2` and rule2 minTrailingSilence 0.8
Test: a factory whose `needsPreparation` returns true makes RecordingController emit LOADING with `preparingNpu == true`
No reference to `OnlineRecognizer.prependAdspLibraryPath` outside `engine/sherpa/QnnRuntime.kt` (`grep -rn prependAdspLibraryPath app/src/main` shows one call site)
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: sherpa API (v1.13.8, `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx`): `QnnConfig(backendLib, contextBinary, systemLib)` is a field `qnnConfig` of `OnlineTransducerModelConfig`; `OnlineRecognizer.prependAdspLibraryPath(newPath: String)` is a `@JvmStatic` companion function. Model type `nemo_transducer` with provider `qnn` selects sherpa's Nemotron QNN implementation. This cannot be exercised on the build machine; the owner verifies it on the device with the Engine check (next task). | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
